description: Read one file on a work item, initiative or program: its name, media type and size, with the content as `text` for a UTF-8 text file (text, Markdown, CSV, JSON, XML, HTML, logs) or as `contentBase64` otherwise (PDF, Office documents, images, zip). Take `fileId` from anyforge_list_program_files, anyforge_list_initiative_files or anyforge_list_work_item_files. Read with your own access, as in the Console: a file you cannot see is not_found. Files up to 2.5 MB; a larger one is refused with file_too_large, open it from the record's Files tab instead. To save a base64 file, decode `contentBase64` (for example `base64 -d > <filename>`).

fileId.description: The file id from the record's file list.

id.description: The work item, initiative or program id.

target.description: The kind of record the file is attached to.

name: anyforge_get_file
title: Get file
